property_summary: For any caller and any recipient address k, calling withdraw either (A) fully reverts on failed low-level send so balances[k] is unchanged (reference), whereas the mutant can succeed while zeroing balances[k] when the callee reverts; thus the reference always preserves balances[k] when the external send to k fails, but the buggy variant may not.
change_summary: Remove the require on the call result so that failed sends do not revert and balances are set to zero regardless, changing post-withdraw balances observable externally.
